messages:
Amira Khan: Hi all, kit arrived this morning. Monitor is fine but the HDMI cable wasn't included and the monitor arm plate is loosehas a weird wobble. Also trying to join corp Wi-Fi but my Mac won't accept the cert during enrollment -- keeps saying 'certificate not trusted'. Created ticket IT-4710. Can someone point me to who handles the extra cable and Wi-Fi join? :slightly_frowning_face:

Rory (IT): Welcome Amira! Tagging myself on IT-4710. For the Wi-Fi cert: are you seeing the enrollment prompt from the SSO portal or from the OS? Can you paste the exact error string and the output of `security find-certificate -a -p | grep -i corp`? Also, which HDMI cable type do you need (HDMI->HDMI or HDMI->USB-C)?

Amira Khan: Error is from macOS network join dialog: "The certificate for this server is invalid." I clicked view cert and it shows issuer as "Redwood CA" and expires 2027. I'm on an M1 MacBook Air. I think the cable is HDMI->HDMI (monitor has HDMI and DisplayPort). No HDMI cable in the foam sleeve.

OnboardingBot: IT-4710 assigned to Rory (IT). Facilities request submitted for an HDMI cable and VESA screw-check: REF-8892. Estimated delivery: same-day drop if on-campus, otherwise next business-day.

Jesse (Facilities): Hi Amira, I can swing by with an HDMI cable and a small VESA screw kit at 3pm. If the arm is loose send a pic of the mounting plate and I'll tighten it. Desk number?

Amira Khan: Thanks Jesse! Desk 4B-12. Pic of the arm/plate: https://imgur.com/def456 (shows wobble around the joint). Also pasted the macOS cert dialog text: "The certificate for this server is invalid. You might be connecting to a server that is pretending to be 'corp-auth.redwood.ai'."

Rory (IT): OK that error usually means the CA isn't in the system keychain. Quick steps: 1) download the CA cert at https://idp.redwood.internal/certs/redwood-ca.pem  2) double-click and install to System keychain 3) open Keychain Access -> find "Redwood CA" -> Get Info -> Set "Always Trust" for SSL. If you prefer, I can push the cert via MDM. Can you try installing and then retry joining Wi-Fi and paste the join dialog outcome? If you hit UAC prompts, send screenshots.

Amira Khan: Installed the PEM into System keychain and set to Always Trust. Re-attempting join now... Success! Connected to corp-secure. Thanks Rory :raised_hands: Looking forward to the cable and the VESA fix at 3pm.

Rory (IT): Great — marking Wi-Fi as resolved in IT-4710. Jesse, please confirm when you drop the cable and tighten the arm so I can close the facilities side.

Jesse (Facilities): Dropped HDMI cable and tightened plate at 3:05pm. Arm wobble fixed. Left a sticky note with the screw set code REF-8892. Closing facilities ticket.

Amira Khan: All sorted, thanks everyone! Appreciate the quick help and the welcome :smile:
